input.quote: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Sections 13.1–13.3 already satisfy the rule (Affiliates and contractors covered, perpetual irrevocable paid-up licence, revocation only for uncured material breach, transfer to Affiliate or successor). Section 14.2 is the outlier: the Deliverable licence is revocable at Vendor's discretion, non-transferable, limited to the Order Form term, and omits Affiliates and contractors — at the walk-away line for work product created for and paid for by us. The redline applies only the rule's targeted fixes (delete "revocable"/"non-transferable", make the licence perpetual and irrevocable, add Affiliates and contractors, add Affiliate/successor transfer keyed to Section 13.3) and leaves Vendor's ownership sentence and the "use a Deliverable" scope untouched; the high changed-character ratio reflects the brevity of this one-sentence grant, in which nearly every element is what the rule requires changing, rather than any expansion of scope.

proposal.summary: Targeted fix to 14.2: delete "revocable"/"non-transferable" and the term limit, add Affiliates and contractors, and permit transfer under Section 13.3.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have conformed the Deliverable licence to the grant in Sections 13.1–13.3, so paid-for Deliverables are licensed perpetually and irrevocably to us, our Affiliates and our contractors, and remain transferable to an Affiliate or successor. A revocable, term-limited, non-transferable licence would leave us unable to keep using work product we paid to have created; if helpful, we can accept coverage of Affiliates on written notice and transfer limited to a successor in an M&A transaction.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on its behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence

ops.oldText: a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: a Deliverable, transferable to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3.
